# AI Music

Generate and edit AI music on RunComfy through one CLI, as a smart router across the music catalog. For premium vocal tracks it routes to ElevenLabs AI Music Generation (44.1 kHz stereo, 5 s to 5 min, section control, 0.0083 dollars per second). For cheaper work it routes to ACE Step or ACE Step 1.5 (tag-driven composition, optional lyrics, multilingual vocals on 1.5, 0.0002 to 0.0003 dollars per second). ACE Step also provides audio-inpaint, to regenerate a time range inside an existing track, and audio-outpaint, to extend a track before or after. Every run is charged by RunComfy at the stated per-second rate of the chosen model.
